user_story: As a user, I want to submit the contact form on the 'Contact Us' page so that I can send feedback to the company. Acceptance Criteria: 1. The form must have the following fields: 'name' (selector: 'input[name="name"]'), 'email' (selector: 'input[name="email"]'), 'subject' (selector: 'input[name="subject"]'), and 'message' (selector: 'textarea#message'). 2. Upon successful submission, the user should remain on the same page (URL: 'https://automationexercise.com/contact_us'). 3. If any required field is left empty and the user attempts to submit, the form should not submit and the user should remain on the same page (URL: 'https://automationexercise.com/contact_us').
As a new user, I want to register for a free online account so that I can access banking services. I should be able to fill out the registration form and submit it successfully to create my account.
As a user, I want to submit a contact form on the Practice Software Testing website so that I can get in touch with the team. The form should validate required fields before submission.

As a user, I want to submit a contact form so that I can send feedback to the website administrators. The form should include fields for my name, email, subject, and message. Upon submitting the form, I should be redirected to a success page if the submission is valid.

As a user, I want to log into my bank account from the ParaBank website so that I can manage my finances. I should be able to enter my username and password and click the 'Log In' button to access my account. Additionally, I want to see the 'Forgot login info?' and 'Register' links for assistance if needed.

As a user, I want to submit a contact form so that I can get in touch with the support team. The form should validate the required fields before submission. 
Acceptance Criteria:
1. The 'first_name' field with selector '#first_name' must be required.
2. The 'last_name' field with selector '#last_name' must be required.
3. The 'email' field with selector '#email' must be required and validate email format.
4. The 'message' field with selector '#message' must be required.
5. Upon successful submission, the form should redirect to the same page with no validation errors.
6. The submit button with selector 'input[data-test="contact-submit"]' should be enabled only when all required fields are filled correctly.
As a user, I want to view the list of test cases on the Automation Exercise website so that I can understand the available test scenarios for UI testing.

As a user, I want to view the list of test cases on the Automation Exercise website so that I can select and learn about various testing scenarios. Acceptance Criteria: The user should be able to see the heading 'Test Cases' and a list of test cases, including 'Test Case 1: Register User', 'Test Case 2: Login User with correct email and password', and others, with links that expand to show details. The main page URL should be 'https://automationexercise.com/test_cases'.

As a user, I want to view the list of test cases on the Automation Exercise website so that I can understand the functionalities being tested. I should be able to see the test case titles and their descriptions when I click on them.

As a user, I want to view the list of test cases on the automation exercise page so that I can understand the testing scenarios available for practice. Acceptance criteria: The page should display the title 'Automation Practice Website for UI Testing - Test Cases' and the headings 'Test Cases' and 'Subscription'. Additionally, the test cases should be listed with clickable links that expand to show details.

As a user, I want to view a list of test cases on the Automation Exercise website so that I can understand the functionalities available for testing. I need to ensure the test cases are displayed correctly and that I can access detailed information for each case.

As a user, I want to view the list of test cases available on the Automation Exercise website so that I can understand the functionality being tested. Acceptance Criteria: 1. The page title should be 'Automation Practice Website for UI Testing - Test Cases'. 2. The page should display the heading 'Test Cases'. 3. The links for each test case should be visible and clickable, including 'Test Case 1: Register User', 'Test Case 2: Login User with correct email and password', and so on. 4. The page should include a subscription input field with the placeholder 'Your email address' and a button with the text 'Subscribe'.

As a user, I want to view the API endpoint documentation list on the Automation Exercise website so that I can understand the available APIs for testing. Acceptance Criteria: 1. The page title should be 'Automation Practice for API Testing'. 2. The page should display the heading 'APIs List for practice'. 3. The page should include a subscription input field with the placeholder 'Your email address'. 4. The page should have a button with the ID 'subscribe' that allows users to subscribe. 5. The page should display links to various API endpoints, such as 'API 1: Get All Products List'.
As a user, I want to fill out the text box form with my full name, email, current address, and permanent address so that I can submit my information successfully.

As a user, I want to fill out the text box form so that I can submit my details for processing. Acceptance Criteria: 
1. The form should include an input field with id 'userName' for entering the full name. 
2. The form should include an input field with id 'userEmail' for entering the email address. 
3. The form should include a textarea with id 'currentAddress' for entering the current address. 
4. The form should include a textarea with id 'permanentAddress' for entering the permanent address. 
5. Upon clicking the 'Submit' button (id 'submit'), the URL should not change if the form is submitted empty.

As a user, I want to fill out the text box form so that I can provide my full name, email, current address, and permanent address. Upon submission, I expect my inputs to be processed and displayed correctly.
As a user, I want to fill out the text box form with my name, email, current address, and permanent address so that I can submit my information successfully.

As a user, I want to fill out the text box form with my name, email, and addresses so that I can submit my information. Acceptance criteria: 1. The form must have an input field with id 'userName' for entering full name. 2. The form must have an input field with id 'userEmail' for entering email. 3. The form must have a textarea with id 'currentAddress' for entering the current address. 4. The form must have a textarea with id 'permanentAddress' for entering the permanent address. 5. There must be a button with id 'submit' that submits the form. 6. Upon submission with valid data, the URL should not change and the form remains visible. 7. If the form is submitted empty, the URL should not change, and the form remains visible.

As a user, I want to fill out the text box form on the demoqa website so that I can submit my personal information and see it displayed correctly. Acceptance Criteria: 1. The user must be able to enter their full name in the input field with id 'userName'. 2. The user must be able to enter their email address in the input field with id 'userEmail'. 3. The user can enter their current address in the textarea with id 'currentAddress'. 4. The user can enter their permanent address in the textarea with id 'permanentAddress'. 5. Upon clicking the button with id 'submit', the form data must be displayed correctly. 6. If the form is submitted without entering any data, the URL must remain the same.

As a user, I want to interact with alert and confirm dialogs so that I can test the response of the application to user actions. Acceptance criteria: When I click the button with id 'alertButton', an alert dialog should appear. When I click the button with id 'confirmButton', a confirmation dialog should appear.

As a user, I want to interact with alert and confirm dialogs on the Alerts page so that I can verify their functionality. Acceptance Criteria: 1. Clicking the button with ID 'alertButton' triggers an alert dialog. 2. Clicking the button with ID 'confirmButton' triggers a confirm dialog. 3. The user can confirm or cancel the confirm dialog and the subsequent actions are verified.

As a user, I want to be able to interact with alert and confirm dialogs so that I can receive notifications and confirm actions. 
Acceptance Criteria:
1. Clicking the button with id 'alertButton' should trigger an alert dialog.
2. Clicking the button with id 'confirmButton' should trigger a confirm dialog and the user should be able to confirm or cancel the action.
3. The URL should remain the same after interacting with the dialogs.

As a user, I want to interact with alert and confirm dialogs so that I can test the alert functionalities of the application. Acceptance Criteria: When I click the button with id 'alertButton', an alert dialog should appear. When I click the button with id 'confirmButton', a confirm dialog should appear. The URL should remain the same throughout these interactions.

As a user, I want to be able to interact with alert and confirm dialogs on the Alerts page so that I can see how the application handles these interactions. Acceptance Criteria: 1. When I click the button with id 'alertButton', an alert dialog should appear. 2. When I click the button with id 'confirmButton', a confirm dialog should appear. 3. The URL should remain the same after interactions with the dialogs.

As a user, I want to be able to trigger alert and confirm dialogs so that I can receive notifications or confirmations from the application. 
Acceptance Criteria:
1. When I click the button with id 'alertButton', an alert dialog should appear.
2. When I click the button with id 'confirmButton', a confirm dialog should appear.
3. The URL should remain the same after clicking the buttons.

As a user, I want to manage my data in an editable web table by adding, editing, and deleting records so that I can maintain an up-to-date list of information. Acceptance Criteria: I can click the button with id 'addNewRecordButton' to add a new record. After adding a record, the record should appear in the table. I can edit an existing record by interacting with the respective row in the table. I can delete a record and it should no longer be visible in the table.

As a user, I want to start and stop the progress bar so that I can see the progress of an operation. Acceptance Criteria: 1. When I click the button with id 'startStopButton' and its text is 'Start', the progress bar should start progressing. 2. When I click the button with id 'startStopButton' and its text is 'Stop', the progress should stop. 3. The URL should remain the same: 'https://demoqa.com/progress-bar'.

As a user, I want to start and stop the progress bar so that I can see the progress of an ongoing task. Acceptance Criteria: 1. When I click the button with id 'startStopButton' and its text is 'Start', the progress bar should start. 2. When I click the button with id 'startStopButton' and its text is 'Stop', the progress bar should stop.

As a user, I want to be able to start and stop the progress bar so that I can observe its behavior. Acceptance criteria: 
1. When the user clicks the button with id 'startStopButton', the progress bar should start. 
2. When the user clicks the button again, the progress bar should stop. 
3. The button should initially display the text 'Start'.

As a user, I want to be able to start and stop the progress bar on the Progress Bar page so that I can see the progress of the loading process. Acceptance Criteria: 
1. When I click the button with id 'startStopButton' and the text 'Start', the progress bar should begin to fill. 
2. When I click the same button again, the progress should stop, and the button text should change to 'Start' again.

As a user, I want to start and stop the progress bar so that I can see the progress of an ongoing operation. Acceptance Criteria: 
1. When I click the button with id 'startStopButton' and text 'Start', the progress bar should begin to fill. 
2. Clicking the same button again should stop the progress. 
3. The button text should change appropriately during these actions, although specific text assertions are not required.

As a user who has forgotten their login information, I want to be able to retrieve my login details by filling out the 'Forgot login info?' form so that I can access my account. Acceptance Criteria: 1. The form must include fields for 'First Name', 'Last Name', 'Address', 'City', 'State', 'Zip Code', and 'SSN' as specified in the element inventory. 2. When the form is submitted with valid data, the user should be redirected to the next relevant page. 3. If the form is submitted without filling out any fields, the user should remain on the same page and the URL should not change.

As a user who has forgotten their login information, I want to retrieve my login details using the 'Forgot login info?' form on the ParaBank website so that I can regain access to my account.

Acceptance Criteria:
1. The form must include inputs for 'First Name', 'Last Name', 'Address', 'City', 'State', 'Zip Code', and 'SSN' with corresponding IDs: 'firstName', 'lastName', 'address.street', 'address.city', 'address.state', 'address.zipCode', 'ssn'.
2. The form must have a submit button with the value 'Find My Login Info' and class 'button'.
3. Upon successful form submission, the user should remain on the same page if the form is not filled out correctly, and the URL should remain as 'https://parabank.parasoft.com/parabank/lookup.htm'.
4. If the form is filled out correctly, the appropriate action should be triggered (exact verification not defined).

As a user, I want to add, complete, and delete todos in the TodoMVC application so that I can manage my tasks efficiently. Acceptance Criteria: 1. When I enter a new todo in the input field with the selector 'input[data-testid="text-input"]' and press Enter, the todo should be added to the list. 2. When I check the checkbox with the selector 'input[data-testid="toggle-all"]', all todos should be marked as completed. 3. When I click the button with the class 'clear-completed', all completed todos should be removed from the list.

As a user, I want to be able to add, complete, and delete todos in the TodoMVC application so that I can manage my tasks efficiently. Acceptance Criteria: 1. The user can add a new todo by typing in the input field with `data-testid: text-input` and pressing Enter. 2. The user can complete a todo by clicking the checkbox with `id: toggle-all`. 3. The user can delete completed todos by clicking the button with `class: clear-completed`. 4. The todo list updates correctly after each action, and the URL remains the same when adding an empty todo.

As a user, I want to add, complete, and delete tasks in my todo list so that I can manage my tasks effectively. Acceptance Criteria: 
1. I can add a new todo by typing in the input field with aria-label 'New Todo Input' and pressing enter. 
2. I can complete a todo by clicking the toggle-all checkbox with data-testid 'toggle-all'. 
3. I can delete completed todos by clicking the button with class 'clear-completed'.

As a user, I want to add, complete, and delete todos in the TodoMVC application so that I can manage my tasks efficiently. Acceptance Criteria: 1. When I enter a todo in the input field with aria-label 'New Todo Input' and press enter, the todo should appear in the list. 2. When I click the checkbox with id 'toggle-all', all todos should be marked as completed. 3. When I click the button with class 'clear-completed', all completed todos should be removed from the list.

As a user, I want to add, complete, and delete todos in the TodoMVC application so that I can manage my tasks effectively.

Acceptance Criteria:
- The user can add a new todo by entering text in the input field with the selector 'input[data-testid="text-input"]' and pressing Enter.
- The user can complete a todo by checking the checkbox with the selector 'input#toggle-all'.
- The user can delete completed todos using the button with the selector 'button.clear-completed'.
- The list updates correctly to reflect the new state of the todos, and the footer displays the correct count of items left.

As a user, I want to interact with the collapsible accordion sections on the Accordian page so that I can view information on 'What is Lorem Ipsum?', 'Where does it come from?', and 'Why do we use it?'.

As a user, I want to interact with the collapsible accordion sections on the Accordian page so that I can view additional information when needed. 
Acceptance Criteria:
1. The button with class 'accordion-button' and text 'What is Lorem Ipsum?' should be clickable and expand to show the relevant content.
2. The button with class 'accordion-button collapsed' and text 'Where does it come from?' should be clickable and expand to show the relevant content.
3. The button with class 'accordion-button collapsed' and text 'Why do we use it?' should be clickable and expand to show the relevant content.
4. After clicking on the 'What is Lorem Ipsum?' button, the URL should remain 'https://demoqa.com/accordian'.
5. The accordion sections should collapse when clicking on an already expanded section.

As a user, I want to select a date using the date picker so that I can easily choose a specific date for my events. Acceptance Criteria: 1. The date picker should allow selection of a date when the input with id 'datePickerMonthYearInput' is clicked. 2. After selecting a date, the input with id 'datePickerMonthYearInput' should display the chosen date correctly.

As a user, I want to see tooltips with additional information when I hover over certain elements, so that I can understand their purpose without clicking on them. Acceptance Criteria: When the user hovers over the input field with id 'toolTipTextField', a tooltip should appear. When the user hovers over the button with id 'toolTipButton', a tooltip should also appear.

As a user, I want to see tooltips with information when I hover over the elements so that I can understand their purpose without clicking them. Acceptance Criteria: 1. When I hover over the input field with id 'toolTipTextField', a tooltip should appear. 2. When I hover over the button with id 'toolTipButton', a tooltip should appear. The tooltips should reveal relevant information about these elements.

As a user, I want to see tooltips with information about elements when I hover over them, so that I can understand their functionality without clicking on them. Acceptance Criteria: 1. When I hover over the input field with id 'toolTipTextField', a tooltip appears. 2. When I hover over the button with id 'toolTipButton', a tooltip appears. 3. The URL remains 'https://demoqa.com/tool-tips' after hovering.
As a user, I want to hover over elements on the Tool Tips page to see relevant information so that I can understand their purpose without clicking them.
As a user, I want to see tooltips with helpful information when I hover over certain elements on the Tool Tips page, so that I can understand their functions better.
